test_cases.title: Test Logon and Reset of Low Pressure Alarm
preconditions: User is logged into the GUI
steps: Click the logon button to trigger the logon process
Verify the system transitions to the 'Low Pressure Alarm State' for low pressure
expected: System transitions to 'Low Pressure Alarm State'

test_cases.title: Test Triggering of Low Pressure Alarm with High Priority
steps: Verify the system transitions to the 'Low Pressure Alarm State' with high priority
Check for immediate reset upon first breath above threshold
expected: System transitions to 'Low Pressure Alarm State' with high priority and resets upon first breath above threshold

test_cases.title: Test Triggering of Pressure High Alarm
preconditions: Pressure above threshold for 3+ consecutive breaths
steps: Simulate high pressure event for three consecutive breaths
Verify the system transitions to the 'Pressure High Alarm State'
Check if the alarm remains active until reset
expected: System transitions to 'Pressure High Alarm State' and remains active until reset

test_cases.title: Test Emission of Sound for Pressure High Alarm
steps: Simulate the activation of the sound event
Verify the system emits a sound when the Pressure High Alarm is active
expected: System emits a sound when the Pressure High Alarm is active

test_cases.title: Test Display of Pressure High Alarm
steps: Click the cancel button to attempt to reset the Pressure High Alarm
Verify the system transitions to the 'No Alarm State' or appropriate state
expected: System transitions to 'No Alarm State' or appropriate state after cancel button click

test_cases.title: Test Visibility of Alarm State with No Audible Sound
steps: Verify the system maintains the 'Alarm State' visually
Check for visual indication of alarm state without sound
expected: System visually indicates alarm state without sound

test_cases.title: Test Priority of PIP Too High Alarm
steps: Set the PIP value to the commanded value plus 5cm H2O
Verify the system triggers the 'PIP Too High Alarm State' with high priority
expected: System transitions to 'PIP Too High Alarm State' with high priority

test_cases.title: Test Default Value for PIP Too High Alarm
steps: Set the PIP value to the commanded value
Verify the system triggers the 'PIP Too High Alarm State' with the correct default value
expected: System transitions to 'PIP Too High Alarm State' with the correct default value

test_cases.title: Test Initial State of Alarm System
steps: Define and verify the initial state of the alarm system before any events occur
expected: System in 'No Alarm State' with no visual or audible indicators

test_cases.title: Test Mode Switching Behavior
steps: Define and verify the mode switching behavior between different alarm states
expected: System transitions smoothly between states without loss of information or functionality
